description: A [[path_models]] entry covering the workspace sends the turn to that directory's model and effort instead of the configured one.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[[path_models]]
path = "{workspace}"
model = "dir-model"
[[path_models]]
path = "{workspace}/elsewhere"
model = "inner-model"
